subject: POC planning & final readout scheduling - NovaCare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Grace Lee <grace.lee@novacare.com>, John Sato <john.sato@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: POC planning - next steps & success criteria (NovaCare)

Hi Grace / John —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into the trial: 

Summary / success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: p99 generation latency <= 450ms for 512-token responses on our dedicated instance
- Accuracy: match/beat current baseline on your NER & routing tests (F1 improvement >= 5%)
- Cost: projected per-API-call cost under $0.03 for standard inference profile during evaluation
- Reliability: no more than 1% failed requests during 2‑week trial

POC plan (proposed):
- Scope: 2-week sandbox trial (production-scale sample), Redwood will provision a dedicated instance with config X (GPU pool: T4x4 equivalent).
- Data: NovaCare to provide a sanitized sample dataset + evaluation prompts (see attachment: NovaCare_POC_success_criteria.xlsx) by Tue 2026-08-19.
- Ownership:
  - NovaCare: dataset, evaluation rubric, exec/CS attend for final readout (Grace / John)
  - Redwood: instance provisioning, test harness, weekly status check-ins (Marcus will own infra setup)
- Timeline: target start Mon 2026-08-24, trial window 8/24–9/4, final readout the week of 9/7 (exec summary + metrics)

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above and the target start date? Also confirm who from your team will own procurement/contract conversation so we can loop them in early.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaCare.docx) and a short env setup note for Marcus to finish.

Thanks — looking forward to the trial.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0108
